This is a textbook stack-based buffer overflow and is directly reachable through the `copy` action using `argv[2]`.

rag_summaries.mitigation: Upgrade Poco to a patched version or sanitize/validate ZIP entry names before extraction, rejecting absolute paths and .. components. Avoid extracting untrusted archives with elevated privileges.
